integrity: All symbolic identities are checked with exact rational arithmetic; finite numerical trajectories are illustrative rather than proof of global claims; same-model scientific review only.
scientific_limitations: Specific deterministic Hawk–Dove coefficients and clipped imitation rule; no global closed-form stable manifold; ecological limit is a convergent trajectory integral; classification does not address stochastic finite populations or parameter variations.
title: A one-sided opinion threshold, curved basin boundary, and resource memory in a Hawk–Dove feedback game
